questions.question: When Jeremiah told the people the LORD said not to go to Egypt, what did Johanan and the arrogant men answer?
The LORD commanded the people to stay in Judah. Johanan and the commanders obeyed and stayed there. True or false?
After the people reached Tahpanhes in Egypt, what did the LORD tell Jeremiah to do while the Jews watched?

answers.text: Bury large stones in the pavement
Break a clay jar by the gate
Wear a yoke through the streets

questions.question: At Tahpanhes in Egypt, the LORD told Jeremiah He would send for which king to strike down Egypt?
